name: Monique
source:
It might feel like you're being interrogated by the cool and calculating Monique - but she's just a moneyed maiden making sure you're prepared for life. While Monique is confident in pre-planning and managing schedules, she tends to feel lost when it comes to small talk: it's easier to be professional than personal. Outside of logistics, It's almost as if the inside of the safe seems to be all she knows.
Likes: Tabulations, Balances, Sophia 
Dislikes: Inattention, Sloppiness, Debt

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
